name: nf_hackathons_search_config
description: Search configuration for the nf-hackathons SearchIndex, syn75081639. Default analyzer is the built-in STANDARD (tokenize + lowercase, no stemming) so names/free-text stay searchable; per-column overrides (org.synapse.nf-nf_hackathons_columns) route id fields to IDENTIFIER, discovery free-text (summary, diseaseFocus, manifestation) to the nf_scientific_synonyms analyzer, and clean categorical/facet fields to KEYWORD. Bind only to syn75081639.
